analysis.bertopic.calculate_probabilitie.description: When true, BERTopic computes soft topic probabilities per document (slower / more memory). Default false keeps hard assignments only.

analysis.bertopic.embedding_model.description: Sentence-transformers embedding model id (short name or Hub path). Default is fast and English-tuned; upgrade to all-mpnet-base-v2 for higher quality at higher cost.

analysis.bertopic.label_words.description: How many top words are joined into the human-readable topic label (must be ≤ top_n_words in practice).

analysis.bertopic.min_topic_size.description: Minimum number of documents (segments) required to form a topic. Lower values yield more, finer topics; higher values merge small clusters.

analysis.bertopic.nr_topics.description: Topic-count policy: `auto` lets BERTopic reduce topics after fit, or a positive integer string (e.g. `12`) to target that many topics.

analysis.bertopic.top_n_words.description: Number of representative words retained per topic representation.
